Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Joron Reshun: 21-year-old man, 161 cm (short), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-2-light. Face: square compact face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, medium-loose, deliberate accent: contrasting clipped section. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a small throat necklace; a wrapped keepsake cord. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
